```{r}
### WARNING ###
# When you render this file, a .csv file with the randomized trial order
# will be generated in data/tidy/audio/sentence_completion_task/trials folder.
# The name will be generated based on what's already in the folder
# (e.g., 000, 001, 002 ...)
# The name matches the participant's ID.

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)

# load stimuli
stim <- read_csv(here("stim","sentence_completion_task","sentence-completion_rhotic.csv")) %>%
  mutate(
    stimulus = str_replace(
      port_sentence,
      fixed(lexical_item),
      str_dup("_", str_length(lexical_item))
    )
  )

# randomize stimuli
stim_randomized <- stim[sample(nrow(stim)),] %>%
  mutate(
  trial = row_number()
    )
```

```{r, results='asis'}
# generate slides
for (i in seq_len(nrow(stim_randomized))) {

  cat("#\n\n")

  cat(sprintf(
    "![](../images/%s.avif){width=50%%}\n\n",
    stim_randomized$sentence_code[i]
  ))

  cat(stim_randomized$stimulus[i], "\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
# output randomized trials as csv
dat_dir <- here("data","audio","sentence_completion_task","trials")

# list existing files in dir
existing_files <- list.files(path = dat_dir, pattern = "^[0-9]+")

# get ID numbers
existing_numbers <- as.numeric(gsub("^([0-9]+).*", "\\1", existing_files))

# assign current presentation following number
next_number <- if (length(existing_numbers) == 0) 1 else max(existing_numbers) + 1

# format number correctly
formatted_number <- sprintf("%03d", next_number)

# name new file
new_filename <- paste0(formatted_number, ".csv")

# get new file path
new_file_path <- here("data","audio","sentence_completion_task","trials",new_filename)

# write file
write_csv(stim_randomized, new_file_path)

```
